value.title: Trout Fishing in Another World! With a Side of Hot Oni
value.synopsis: Rin receives an unexpected opportunity after fishing an adventurer out of a lake.

value.title: Combine Your Friends and Ingredients for a Tasty Rice Dish!
value.synopsis: Mouths watering for a taste of real food, Vil's party gleefully welcomes Rin as their newest member. Meanwhile, concerns about the Saintess Summoning grow.

value.title: War on the Water! Seafood Barbeque!
value.synopsis: What begins as a survey mission turns into a rescue operation for a beached orca. That just so happens to be telepathic.

value.title: The Food Demon Descends! Thou Art Tartar Sauce!
value.synopsis: Dungeons aren't supposed to appear without warning, but this one did. Fearing a potential threat to the city, the Guild asks Smorgasbord to investigate.

value.title: Listen Up, Boys! It`s a Dungeon Meat Fest!
value.synopsis: A Wild Ox can only mean one thing: meat's back on the menu for Rin and her party. It's a good thing, too, since they'll need their strength to uncover the dungeon's secrets.

value.title: We Like Conger Eel, But We Love Freshwater Eeel, Too!
value.synopsis: Rin discovers Gomamiso's true identity and uncovers a troubling clue about the Saintess Summoning.

value.title: The Muchi Dango on Your Waist! Please Give Me Every Last One!
value.synopsis: Rin helps the local church improve their food.

value.title: Stew & Ikura: "Who Do You Choose, Me or Her?!" Rice: "I Love You Both!"
value.synopsis: Smorgasbord looks forward to Merlowa's famous spring salt. Unfortunately, they're about to be drawn into the local crisis.

value.title: Crispy Solution, Crunchy Reconciliation! `Cause It`s Tempura!
value.synopsis: They say a way to a dragon's heart is through its stomach.

value.title: Hyahha! It`s Tartar Sauce Time! (For the 2nd Time in 5 Episodes)
value.synopsis: Vi hesitates to return to the capital and face his family.

value.title: A Midnight Cuban Sandwich Tastes Like Sin!
value.synopsis: Everything Rin thought she knew is about to change.

value.title: Otsu-curry-sama! But the Adventure Continues, on and on!
value.synopsis: Rin vows to save her friends from their fated deaths in the depths of a secret dungeon.
